item.title: v2.7.0
item.description:
v2.7.0

Pre-release acceptance item: Physical-reboot Pi restoration is still pending the actual macOS reboot gate. It is not a shipped 2.7.0 capability. Remove this note only after that gate passes.

What’s new

  • One searchable session workspace. Browse Needs you, Ready to continue, In progress, and History sessions with ranked search, keyboard navigation, responsive rows, and preserved browser state.
  • Owner-first navigation. Row click and Return use Open in <owner> for the canonical application or terminal. Open Chat remains a separate action for supported Agent Visor conversation views.
  • Provider-aware Chat. View bounded provider history with grouped work, reasoning, tools, images, questions, approvals, pagination, Details, and capability-correct composer actions.
  • Electron settings and native services. Configure theme, content size, menu-bar pills, full-screen visibility, shortcuts, notifications, Chat visibility, Codex usage, and agent connections from one Settings surface.
  • Safer local integrations. Claude Code, Codex, and Auggie use explicit connection controls; Pi installs only Agent Visor’s bundled metadata-only extension; Cursor and Zed remain read-only.
  • Responsive and accessible controls. Sessions and Chat support keyboard navigation, named actions, read-only states, and content scaling from 80% through 250%.

Improvements and fixes

  • Provider-origin filtering removes known injected task metadata while preserving user-authored quoted content, links, images, and unknown or ambiguous records.
  • Chat delivery uses request and provider identity, bounded recovery, safe cancellation, and per-session draft restoration.
  • Menu-bar recent-session ordering, overflow counts, Ready acknowledgment, and display/full-screen behavior use source-backed evidence and stable attention rules.
  • The signed native helper keeps Accessibility, global shortcuts, display topology, notifications, Dock badges, and exact owner focus behind a narrow macOS boundary.
  • Settings use a private mode 0700 directory, mode 0600 file, and atomic replacement. Known Swift preferences migrate into the Electron settings store.

Known limitations

  • Inspect, hide, unhide, and custom-recording controls are deferred from the first Electron release.
  • Claude usage is hidden until a provider-authoritative credential route exists.
  • Cursor Chat is read-only. Zed-hosted Chat is read-only and exact sidebar/thread reveal is best effort. Auggie remains observe-only.
  • Historical, ended, and unsupported sessions are read-only. Sending and approval controls require a verified provider route for the current session.
  • Updates validate a newer three-part version, matching HTTPS GitHub ZIP URL, and expected Ed25519 signature metadata shape before opening its GitHub release page for manual installation. The Electron updater does not cryptographically verify ZIP bytes; Sparkle Ed25519 signing still protects published archive metadata for compatible consumers. The app does not install updates in place.
  • The cutover copies only the staging Electron profile (~/Library/Application Support/Agent Visor Next) into the production profile (~/Library/Application Support/Agent Visor) when the source is not live. A live source defers import, leaves that source untouched, and excludes transient Electron lock markers from the copy. Provider transcripts, databases, hooks, and live session records remain in place and are outside this profile operation.

Rollback: the exact rollback artifact is the public Swift Agent Visor v2.6.1 build 53. Quit Agent Visor 2.7.0, install the verified v2.6.1 ZIP, and launch it from /Applications. If you installed with Homebrew, do not run brew uninstall --zap while retaining diagnostic profiles; the zap operation removes the application data paths.

item.title: v2.6.1
item.description:
v2.6.1

What’s new

  • Sessions now return to their owning app. Row clicks and Return open Ghostty, Codex, Zed, or another owner. Open Chat stays separate.
  • Rapid session switches are reliable. Agent Visor runs focus requests in order, skips stale requests, and keeps the latest destination.

Improvements and fixes

  • Removed the invisible external-display menu-bar click target and the synthetic notch on displays without a physical notch.
  • Fixed Pi names before the first message and across custom transcript records with nested identifiers.
  • Moved blocking process, liveness, transcript, and machine reads away from shared session threads, with bounded subprocess deadlines.
  • Clarified Sessions and Chat controls with separate hover surfaces, larger Back targets, and direct Open in <owner> labels.
  • Hardened provider ownership, watcher scope, phase evidence, and delayed-result freshness without changing source authority.

item.title: v2.6.0
item.description:
v2.6.0

What’s new

  • Restore exact Pi sessions after a Mac restart. Agent Visor can reopen the interactive Pi sessions it was tracking in Ghostty, using each durable session file rather than guessing from a project name or recent directory. Same-boot relaunches and already-running exact owners are excluded to prevent duplicates.
  • First-class Zed-hosted agents. Pi, Codex, and Claude threads hosted through Zed now keep Zed’s thread title and owner identity. Opening a session activates the correct Zed channel and worktree, then uses a verified best-effort sidebar reveal when the title is unique. Zed-hosted Chat remains read-only.

Improvements and fixes

  • Recovered Pi sessions that stayed on Working after a best-effort completion event was dropped. The Pi runtime heartbeat now supplies exact idle evidence, and manual compaction reports its closing boundary.
  • Detected unresolved Codex Desktop questions and elevated-permission requests directly from observed rollout data, so they appear as Needs attention without requiring a terminal hook.
  • Backfilled a Pi runtime’s controlling TTY when its lifecycle event omitted one, preserving exact terminal navigation and input.
  • Prevented stale startup-transcript discovery from publishing duplicate or ghost Pi sessions after /new, /resume, or /fork.
  • Fixed double-tapping Shift leaving the Sessions browser visible but covered by another application.
  • Reduced status-pulse work on high-refresh displays and stabilized both menu-bar ownership boundaries to prevent pill flapping during activation and display changes.
  • Made Claude usage more compact and explicit with a fixed CC $remaining glance while retaining the full used/limit breakdown in the popover.

Pi reboot restoration is intentionally limited to exact, persisted, interactive Ghostty sessions observed by Agent Visor. It does not replay prompts, restore unsupported hosts, or create substitute sessions when an exact session file is unavailable.

item.title: v2.5.1
item.description:
v2.5.1

What is fixed

  • Fixed severe CPU and memory pressure in large Pi sessions. Agent Visor now coalesces transcript refreshes, skips unchanged files, and decodes only appended JSONL records after the initial index build.
  • Prevented Agent Visor from replaying completion notifications, sounds, and visual attention while a session remains continuously Ready, including during transcript hydration or attachment metadata changes.
  • Stabilized accidentally resumed Pi sessions by keeping the first live runtime as the session owner until it exits, preventing PID/terminal oscillation and misrouted actions.
  • Reduced menu-bar packing work by caching fixed-font pill and overflow measurements without changing session priority or collision safety.

Improvement

  • Sessions and Chat now share one persistent Content font size setting from 80% to 250%. Use Command-Plus, Command-Minus, or Command-0 to adjust or reset it without affecting menu-bar pills and fixed controls.

Pi still performs one initial transcript index build after Agent Visor launches or first opens an uncached session. Later unchanged checks read no transcript bytes, and normal growth reads only the appended range.

item.title: v2.5.0
item.description:
v2.5.0

  • Added zero-configuration Pi support for live and saved sessions, lifecycle recovery, searchable Chat history, and exact-terminal navigation and continuation.
  • Added safe Pi image submission: thumbnails are preserved in Agent Visor and ordered image paths plus optional text are delivered to the owning Pi terminal as one prompt without changing the clipboard.
  • Reworked Sessions into a responsive in-window Chat workspace with grouped turns, collapsible work details, whole-turn pagination, a compact header, stable owner actions, and preserved search and scroll state.
  • Improved menu-bar packing so the highest-priority session prefix fits safely around application menus, the notch, system status items, and provider usage glances without reordering sessions.
  • Added read-only Claude subscription usage alongside capability-aware Codex usage, and standardized model names using each provider's passive local catalog metadata.
  • Hardened session identity and lifecycle handling across Pi, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, terminal hosts, restarts, resumed sessions, and delayed metadata.

Pi integration installs only Agent Visor's bundled metadata-only lifecycle extension after Pi is detected. It does not change Pi settings, models, packages, or unrelated extensions, and it does not send conversation content over the network.

item.title: v2.4.8
item.description:
v2.4.8

  • Adopted a long-lived release identity so macOS can preserve Accessibility authorization across ordinary future updates.
  • Preserved the packaged signature through Sparkle updates and Homebrew installation.
  • Completed the ordered migration through the required 2.4.7 updater bridge.

Upgrading from an older ad-hoc release requires one final Accessibility grant for the new identity.

item.title: v2.4.7
item.description:
v2.4.7

  • Prepared Agent Visor to keep one stable Accessibility identity across future updates.
  • Updated the in-app updater so it preserves the signature delivered by release packaging.
  • Added release checks that prevent older installations from skipping the required signing migration.

item.title: v2.4.6
item.description:
v2.4.6

  • Accessibility recovery now explains how to replace an enabled-looking stale permission entry with the exact running Agent Visor app.
  • Release validation now supports the current ad-hoc distribution path and an optional Developer ID and notarization path without confusing the two.

item.title: v2.4.5
item.description:
v2.4.5

  • Streamlined Agent Sessions into a compact, search-first browser with clearer section names and denser rows.
  • Fresh installs now use Option-Command with 1-9 for visible pills and 0 for More Sessions. Existing shortcut choices are preserved.
  • Improved Accessibility setup and recovery by identifying the exact running app and separating Agent Visor Dev from the installed release.
  • Corrected Homebrew installation guidance and strengthened release-package verification.

item.title: v2.4.4
item.description:
v2.4.4

  • First Agent Visor release on its dedicated app and update identity.
  • Monitor and navigate Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, and terminal-hosted sessions from the menu bar.
  • Search all recent sessions with keyboard navigation and global shortcuts.
  • Improved multi-display and full-screen pill behavior, source-aware navigation, and Codex usage visibility.
